About the Role

As a Payment Compliance Analyst at Gopay, you’ll help ensure our regulatory reporting and communications with Bank Indonesia are accurate, timely, and well-documented. You’ll be the person who looks closely at the data, challenges inconsistencies, follows through on regulatory letters and invitations, and makes sure every required action is properly tracked and executed. You’ll work closely with Product, Finance, Data, and other teams to turn regulatory requirements into clear and reliable deliverables. If you enjoy working with data, spotting what others may miss, and taking ownership of issue identification through resolution, this role is for you!

What You Will Do

• Responsible for regular and ad hoc regulatory reporting to Bank Indonesia, ensuring submissions are accurate, complete, timely, and supported by appropriate documentation.
• Analyze and validate regulatory data across multiple sources, identify inconsistencies or anomalies, and proactively challenge data before submission.
• Manage Bank Indonesia correspondence end-to-end, including incoming and outgoing letters, requests, invitations, deadlines, and required follow-up actions.
• Escalate data gaps, reporting risks, to Compliance head with clear analysis and recommendations.
• Build and maintain a robust documentation and reporting trail, correspondence, and approvals are complete, and organized.
• Responsible for Bank Indonesia seasonal event/program in coordination with other relevant stakeholders.

What You Will Need

• Have 3–7 years of experience in data management, compliance, reporting, operations, audit, or a similar role within payment industry, banking, fintech, or government body.
• Have hands-on experience preparing regulatory reports or regulatory submissions, preferably to Bank Indonesia or another financial regulator.
• Be highly proficient in data analysis and validation, with strong attention to detail and the ability to identify anomalies, inconsistencies, and data gaps before submission.
• Be comfortable working with large or complex datasets, using tools such as Excel/Google Sheets; SQL, data visualization, or BI tools are a strong advantage.
• Have strong documentation and organizational skills, with the ability to maintain clear records of regulatory correspondence, submissions, deadlines, and follow-up actions.
• Be confident in stakeholder communication and escalation, including asking the right questions, challenging data or information when needed, and following up with multiple teams to get things done.
• Demonstrate strong ownership and judgment, with the ability to manage recurring deliverables independently while knowing when an issue requires escalation to Compliance leadership.

About the Team

You’ll be part of the Payment Compliance team at Gopay, helping ensure GoPay operates responsibly and stays ahead of regulatory expectations in Indonesia’s fast-evolving payment industry. We work closely with Bank Indonesia and teams across the business to turn regulatory requirements into accurate reporting, clear actions, and practical solutions—often solving complex questions where the data tells an important story. What makes this role exciting is the opportunity to see how regulation, data, and real payment products come together, while having a direct impact on how the business operates. If you enjoy digging into data, asking “does this really make sense?”, and turning findings into action, you’ll have plenty of room to make an impact here!

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

About the Role

As a Data Analyst within the GoTo Financial Lending Operations team, you will get hands-on experience in a fast-paced consumer lending environment. You will sit at the intersection of data and daily operations, helping our business run smoothly by ensuring teams have the information they need. This is a fantastic opportunity to dive into the world of Business Intelligence, learn how data drives operational decisions, and develop your technical skills in a supportive, real-world setting.

What You Will Do

• Support Operational Requests: Manage and prioritize incoming data-related queries from the broader operations team.
• Maintain Data Accuracy: Perform routine data refreshes to ensure business continuity and accuracy.
• Monitor Dashboards: Maintain and update existing operational dashboards so the team always has a clear view of performance.
• Extract Insights: Execute ad-hoc data pulls to answer specific, time-sensitive business questions.
• Develop Reporting: Assist in designing and building new operational reports as you grow and learn in the role.

What You Will Need

• 1–2 years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Analysis, Growth Analytics, or a related role; Fresh graduates with strong project portfolios or relevant internship experience are welcome to apply.
• Possess a foundational understanding of Microsoft Excel (e.g., comfortable with basic formulas, filtering, and data entry).
• Demonstrate a strong, genuine eagerness to learn about data analytics and business intelligence.
• Comfortable asking questions and communicating with operational stakeholders to understand their data needs.
• Highly detail-oriented with a proactive, curious mindset.

About the Team

The GoTo Financial Lending Operations team is the engine that keeps our consumer lending business running safely, efficiently, and with a customer-first mindset. We are a dynamic, cross-functional group covering the entire operational lifecycle, including Know Your Customer (KYC), Quality Assurance (QA), Operation Support, CRM Operations, Anti-Fraud, and Customer Service. By joining our team, you will get a 360-degree view of how a lending business operates on the ground floor. You will partner directly with these diverse units, acting as their data liaison to ensure they have the insights necessary to protect our business and serve our customers.
